prompts.card_daoming_02:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production postcard artwork for the original Sichuan idle game 旅行癞疙宝, one single full-bleed landscape image, 3:2 aspect ratio, 1536 x 1024 composition.
Input image 1 is solely the character identity and gouache style reference, not a composition to copy. Create a new original invented scene informed by Sichuan life, not an exact depiction of a named landmark.
Character invariants: the same original wide, very squat sleepy olive toad as the reference; heavy-lidded small amber eyes, broad relaxed mouth, cream belly, a few olive wart marks, bean-shaped ear glands, short stout limbs; no clothes. The indigo cloth satchel with a white floral mark and tiny red chili knot is its only travel accessory. Keep a believable single pair of forelimbs and hindlimbs, clear gentle pose.
Style: quiet 2D gouache storybook painting, restrained warm brown outlines, matte olive greens, ochres, cream and indigo, subtle handmade paint texture, calm lived-in environmental details. Match reference illustration, never realistic 3D or glossy render.
Composition: toad occupies approximately 18–24 percent of the total image width; environment carries the story. Use a distinct scene-specific viewpoint. Keep the entire full-bleed scene painted to all edges.
Constraints: one toad only, no other characters or visible humans, no text, signage lettering, logos, UI, border, frame, watermark, or split panels.
Scene and action: In a quiet rural Daoming-inspired courtyard, the toad sits at a low bamboo work bench, slowly sorting short and long thin bamboo strips into two loose groups. A strip rests in its small forefeet; it is a curious beginner simply sorting material, not a master weaver and not weaving a complex object. Rolled bamboo mats rest beside a rough wall, with a modest old tile roof and soft courtyard greenery. Its indigo bag sits beside the bench. An intimate but environment-rich courtyard view in soft late-morning daylight; handmade bamboo textures and small mismatched piles communicate a quiet moment.
